title: PE-EK-PINN: Physics Embedding with Evolving Kernel for Scalable Physics-Informed Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2609.38023v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) embed governing equations into deep learning, but enforce them only through loss residuals, leaving highly oscillatory wave behavior to be discovered by optimization. As a result, methods that achieve relative $L_2$ errors below $10^{-3}$ on standard manufactured Helmholtz benchmarks can fail on practical radiation problems involving singular excitations, absorbing boundaries, and wave fields spanning tens of wavelengths. Architectural physics embedding addresses this limitation by factorizing the field into analytically derived oscillatory kernels and learnable envelopes. However, the kernel dictionary must be manually constructed and scales with the number of elementary units, growing exponentially with the depth of hierarchically structured systems such as antenna arrays and metasurfaces. translated_title: PE-EK-PINN：面向可扩展物理信息神经网络的演化核物理嵌入方法
translated_abstract: 物理信息神经网络（PINNs）将控制方程嵌入深度学习中，但仅通过损失残差来施加约束，使得高度振荡的波动行为需要依靠优化过程来发现。因此，在标准人工构造的亥姆霍兹基准上能够实现相对 $L_2$ 误差低于 $10^{-3}$ 的方法，在涉及奇异激励、吸收边界以及跨越数十个波长尺度的波场的实际辐射问题中可能会失败。架构层面的物理嵌入通过将场分解为解析推导的振荡核和可学习的包络函数来解决这一局限。然而，核字典必须人工构建，且其规模随基本单元数量的增加而增长，对于天线阵列和超表面等具有分层结构的系统，其规模会随层级深度呈指数级增长。我们提出PE-EK-PINN（Physics Embedded with Evolving Kernels，物理嵌入演化核），该方法将物理核视为可重用的……
tldr: 提出PE-EK-PINN方法，将物理核作为可演化、可重用的组件嵌入网络架构中，解决了传统振荡核字典需人工构建且随天线阵列、超表面等分层系统规模呈指数增长的问题，实现了可扩展的高精度波动问题求解。
en_tdlr: PE-EK-PINN treats physics kernels as reusable, evolving components embedded in the network architecture, enabling scalable physics-informed neural networks that overcome the manual construction and exponential growth limitations of oscillatory kernel dictionaries in hierarchically structured wave problems such as antenna arrays and metasurfaces.
